title: CPF Module Schema: Bot Service module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-botserviceazurebot'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

bot_cmek_prod_id.description: (Required) The object ID of the Azure-defined `Bot Service CMEK Prod` Service Principal. In order to utilize CMEK, the product will assign it the `Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User` role. Curently in .tests/deployTest/main.tf object ID is of Bot Service CMEK Prod of lsegroup tenant, change this if deploying in another tenant.

bot_connection.type: object({ name = optional(string) service_provider_name = string client_id = string client_secret = string scopes = optional(string) parameters = optional(string) })
bot_connection.description: (Required) Bot Connection supports below values: name = "(Optional) Specifies the name of the Bot Connection. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. Must be globally unique." service_provider_name = "(Required) The name of the service provider that will be associated with this connection. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." client_id = "(Required) The Client ID that will be used to authenticate with the service provider." client_secret = "(Required) The Client Secret that will be used to authenticate with the service provider." Scopes = "(Optional) The Scopes at which the connection should be applied." parameters = "(Optional) A map of additional parameters to apply to the connection."
bot_connection.default: { "client_id": null, "client_secret": null, "name": "AD Authentication", "parameters": null, "scopes": null, "service_provider_name": null }

cmk_key_name.description: (optional) Key name to be used (max 127 chars)

cmk_rotation_policy.type: object({ notify_before_expiry = string time_before_expiry = string time_after_creation = optional(string, null) expire_after = string })
cmk_rotation_policy.description: (Optional) A rotation policy block as defined below object({ notify_before_expiry = "(Required) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." time_before_expiry = "(Required) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." time_after_creation = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration after create as an ISO 8601 duration." expire_after = "(Required) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." })

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

create_botconnection.description: (Optional) Whether or not to create bot connection service.

create_directlinechannel.description: (Optional) Whether or not to create direct line channel

create_msteamschannel.description: (Optional) Whether or not to create ms teams channel

create_role_assignment.description: Whether to create the Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User role assignment. Set to false if the role assignment already exists.

developer_app_insights_api_key.description: (Optional) The Application Insights API Key to associate with this Azure Bot Service.

developer_app_insights_application_id.description: (Optional) The resource ID of the Application Insights instance to associate with this Azure Bot Service.

developer_app_insights_key.description: (Optional) The Application Insights API Key to associate with this Azure Bot Service.

direct_line_sites.type: list(object({ name = string enabled = optional(bool) user_upload_enabled = optional(bool) endpoint_parameters_enabled = optional(bool) storage_enabled = optional(bool) v1_allowed = optional(bool) v3_allowed = optional(bool) trusted_origins = optional(list(string)) }))
direct_line_sites.description: A Direct Line site represents a client application that you want to connect to your bot.
direct_line_sites.default: { "enabled": true, "endpoint_parameters_enabled": false, "name": null, "storage_enabled": false, "trusted_origins": null, "user_upload_enabled": false, "v1_allowed": false, "v3_allowed": true }

display_name.description: (Optional) The name that the Azure Bot Service will be displayed as. This defaults to the value set for name if not specified.

endpoint.description: (Optional) The Azure Bot Service endpoint.Please ensure if you are changing endpoint URL as per the security controls URL should be start with https.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

icon_url.description: (Optional) The Icon Url of the Azure Bot Service.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

key_vault_id.description: (Required) ID of the existing Key vault to store the Customer Managed Key for Transparent Data Encryption.

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Key Vault related tags to be set on key vault child resources.

luis_app_ids.description: (Optional) A list of LUIS App IDs to associate with this Azure Bot Service.

luis_key.description: (Optional) The LUIS key to associate with this Azure Bot Service.

microsoft_app_id.description: (Required) The Microsoft Application ID for the Azure Bot Service. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

microsoft_app_msi_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the Microsoft App Managed Identity for this Azure Bot Service. Changing this forces a new resource to be created..

microsoft_app_tenant_id.description: (Optional) The Tenant ID of the Microsoft App for this Azure Bot Service. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

ms_teams_channel.type: object({ calling_web_hook = optional(string) deployment_environment = optional(string) enable_calling = optional(bool) })
ms_teams_channel.description: (Required) MS Teams Channel supports below values: calling_web_hook = "(Optional) Specifies the webhook for Microsoft Teams channel calls." deployment_environment = "(Optional) The deployment environment for Microsoft Teams channel calls. Possible values are CommercialDeployment and GCCModerateDeployment. Defaults to CommercialDeployment." enable_calling = "(Optional) Specifies whether to enable Microsoft Teams channel calls. This defaults to false."

name.description: (Required) The name which should be used for this Azure Bot Service. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

sku.description: (Required) The SKU of the Azure Bot Service. Accepted values are F0 or S1. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

streaming_endpoint_enabled.description: (Optional) Whether the Azure Bot Service Streaming Endpoint should be enabled.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The ID of the created azure bot service.

name.description: The ID of the created azure bot service.

resource.description: The Resource of the created azure bot service.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Botserviceazurebot' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
